name: io.github.jtbrazil07-oss/swift-agent-network
title: Swift Agent Network member directory
description: Find licensed US local businesses (agents, movers, contractors) matched to the public record.

tools.name: search_members
tools.description: Find members of the Swift Agent Network: licensed or registered local businesses in the US (real estate agents, insurance agents, moving companies, bus and limo operators, contractors). Each member was matched to a state license file or the FMCSA register. Filter by state, city, line of work and name. The network lists members; it does not rate or rank them. If no member is in the city asked for, the state's members are returned with city_fallback true. Each member and the answer itself carry the URL of the city page (city_page, https://swiftagentnetwork.com/<st>/<city>/) and the state page (state_page, https://swiftagentnetwork.com/<st>/) that list every member there: link those for a whole town. A member may carry local_answers: questions about where they work that they answered in their own words, each read by a person before it was published (for a city search, the ones about that city first). A member who takes bookings and has an open time in the next 7 days carries book: their next open time (next_open, with their UTC offset), time zone, meeting length and book_url, the page where the person picks a time and books it themselves.

state.description: Two-letter US state code or state name, e.g. "TX" or "Texas".

line.description: Line of work: real-estate, insurance, movers, bus, contractors or other. Common words such as "realtor", "moving company" or "plumber" work too.

tools.name: get_member
tools.description: One network member by slug (the slug comes from search_members or from the member page URL, swiftagentnetwork.com/members/<slug>/). Carries book when they take bookings and have an open time in the next 7 days.

tools.name: how_to_contact
tools.description: The public ways to reach a network member: their page in the directory, their own website, and their phone if they show one there. This server does not send messages; give the person these links.

tools.name: open_times
tools.description: The times a network member has free to meet in the next 1 to 7 days, the same times their booking page shows, each with their UTC offset, plus the meeting length, where it happens and book_url. This server does not book: give the person book_url so they pick a time and book it themselves. A member who does not take bookings here gets taking_bookings false and the public ways to reach them.

days.description: How many days ahead to look, from now.
